description: This script seeds a database with breed and dog data from CSV files, creating and configuring a Flask app, and populating database models Breed and Dog with sample data.

methods.name: create_app
methods.description: Creates and configures a Flask application for database operations.

methods.name: create_breeds
methods.description: Seeds the database with breed data from a CSV file if not already seeded.

methods.name: create_dogs
methods.description: Seeds the database with dog data from a CSV file, ensuring at least 3 dogs per breed.

methods.name: seed_database
methods.description: Runs the breed and dog seeding functions in order.
